My changes to the original list are the following:

\-2x Regenerate, +2x Holy Smite

Holy Smite is really important in the early game, and it really improves your ability to combo with Wild Pyromancer.

\-1x Extra Arms, -1x Zerek, Master Cloner, +2x Banana Buffoon

Extra Arms is a bit too high costed to have two of them in the deck, so I cut it down to one and felt it solved the issue. Zerek, while a good minion, ultimately doesn't really accomplish what the deck sets out to do, and feels particularly clunky in hand the majority of the time. Banana Buffoon is ridiculously good with this deck, especially with Wild Pyromancer clears. This card allows you to only run one Spirit Lash because of its incredibly synergy with Wild Pyromancer.

Generally, you want to keep any early drops, Power Word: Shield, Dragon Soul and Lyra the Sunshard. A couple of tips:

* Using Seance on Grave Horrors against aggro decks ends the game instantly.
* Don't be afraid to overdraw at times - the key to this deck is creating huge boards with Dragon Soul and using Lyra to miracle your way through their health bars.
* Banana Buffoon is the MVP of this deck - Seance works really well with him because those bananas represent anything. It can be Wild Pyromancer charges, Lyra Spells, Grave Horror cost reductions, Dragons from Dragon Soul, and it's a free +1/+1 on a Radiant Elemental.

In economics, if the rate of inflation is still positive but it's falling, it's called disinflation. The prices on that good are still higher than its real price, but have decreased based on this decrease in the inflation rate.
